eyebrow.tone: plainspoken, credential-forward (Board-certified, Licensed since, Serving X since)

headline.tone: confident, direct, no superlatives — states what you do and for whom

subheadline.tone: respectful of time; one or two clear sentences about the outcome the client can expect

cta_primary.tone: action-oriented, low-pressure (Schedule a consultation, Book an appointment)

cta_secondary.tone: informational (Our services, How we work, Meet the team)
